spec_raw: Password input needs a show/hide toggle

spec_refined.title: Text input: show/hide toggle for type=password
spec_refined.description: Add an optional visibility toggle button to modus-wc-text-input when type='password'. Clicking the toggle switches the input between masked and plain text and updates the icon and aria-label accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: A new boolean prop enables the toggle only for type='password' (default off)
Clicking the toggle switches input type between password and text
Toggle button has aria-label 'Show password' / 'Hide password' matching state
Toggle is keyboard operable (Enter/Space) and appears in tab order after the input
Existing text-input tests pass; new behavior covered by spec tests
spec_refined.technical_notes: Follow the existing clearable-button pattern inside modus-wc-text-input for slot/positioning.
